title: Running Total and 7-Day Rolling Average
hints: Both metrics are window aggregates over ORDER BY sale_date; the difference is the frame.
Running total: ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW. Rolling 7-day: ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW.
For the first six days the frame simply contains fewer rows; AVG divides by the rows that exist. Round to 2 decimals.
